edits.old: CASE WHEN current_active_employees=0 THEN 'Empty' WHEN current_active_employees<=5 THEN 'Micro' WHEN current_active_employees<=15 THEN 'Small' WHEN current_active_employees<=50 THEN 'Medium' WHEN current_active_employees<=200 THEN 'Large' ELSE 'Enterprise' END organization_size_category,
edits.new: CASE WHEN current_active_employees=0 THEN 'Empty Organization' WHEN current_active_employees<=5 THEN 'Micro Team' WHEN current_active_employees<=15 THEN 'Small Team' WHEN current_active_employees<=50 THEN 'Medium Team' WHEN current_active_employees<=200 THEN 'Large Team' ELSE 'Enterprise Unit' END organization_size_category,

FROM (SELECT w.* FROM rel w LEFT JOIN staging.stg_workday__organization_role_worker ow ON w.worker_id=ow.organization_worker_code AND w.source_relation=ow.source_relation LEFT JOIN staging.stg_workday__organization_role r ON ow.role_id=r.organization_role_id AND ow.source_relation=r.source_relation AND w.organization_id=r.organization_id) rel GROUP BY organization_id,source_relation

edits.old: SELECT ow.organization_id,'workday' source_relation,count(DISTINCT r.organization_role_id) unique_organization_roles,count(DISTINCT ow.organization_worker_code) FILTER(WHERE r.organization_role_code ILIKE '%Manager%') management_role_employees,count(DISTINCT ow.organization_worker_code) FILTER(WHERE r.organization_role_code ILIKE '%Director%') director_role_employees,count(DISTINCT ow.organization_worker_code) FILTER(WHERE r.organization_role_code ILIKE '%Lead%') lead_role_employees FROM staging.stg_workday__organization_role_worker ow LEFT JOIN staging.stg_workday__organization_role r ON ow.organization_id=r.organization_id AND ow.role_id=r.organization_role_id GROUP BY ow.organization_id
edits.new: SELECT w.organization_id,w.source_relation,count(DISTINCT ow.role_id) unique_organization_roles,count(DISTINCT w.worker_id) FILTER(WHERE r.organization_role_code LIKE '%Manager%') management_role_employees,count(DISTINCT w.worker_id) FILTER(WHERE r.organization_role_code LIKE '%Director%') director_role_employees,count(DISTINCT w.worker_id) FILTER(WHERE r.organization_role_code LIKE '%Lead%') lead_role_employees FROM staging.stg_workday__worker_position_organization w LEFT JOIN staging.stg_workday__organization_role_worker ow ON w.worker_id=ow.organization_worker_code AND w.source_relation=ow.source_relation LEFT JOIN staging.stg_workday__organization_role r ON ow.role_id=r.organization_role_id AND ow.source_relation=r.source_relation AND w.organization_id=r.organization_id GROUP BY w.organization_id,w.source_relation
